create_symbol_table_from_dataframe: create a TraceSymbolTable from a pandas DataFrame with name and cat columns using create_from_df
add_symbols_to_table: add a list of symbol strings to a TraceSymbolTable instance using the add_symbols method
encode_dataframe_columns: encode the name and cat columns of a pandas DataFrame with integer IDs using encode_df
decode_symbol_ids_to_names: decode integer symbol IDs back to names in a DataFrame using decode_symbol_id_to_symbol_name
find_matching_symbols: find symbols in a TraceSymbolTable that match a list of regex patterns using find_matched_symbols
